novelty.justification: The novelty route is a measurement/mechanism claim: the embeddings allegedly form a "two-to-three-dimensional manifold recovering group/period" whose axes align with atomic properties "rather than mere co-occurrence frequency." Searches for "element embeddings recover periodic table," "materials model learned element embeddings periodic properties," "Atom2Vec SkipAtom periodic table," and "CGCNN Roost element embedding visualization" identify close precedents including Zhou et al.'s Learning atoms for materials discovery (Atom2Vec, 2018), which recovered chemically meaningful periodic organization from composition-derived embeddings, SkipAtom, and embedding analyses associated with Roost/CGCNN; these already establish the central phenomenon that element-vector geometry reflects chemical similarity. Comparing supervised model embeddings against a PMI baseline, requiring same-group proximity despite rare co-occurrence, and interpreting embedding swaps as physically directional interventions is a non-trivial operational combination, but it is a natural extension of prior element-embedding and mechanistic-intervention work rather than a new core representational relationship.
